title: Give Claude the Keys to Every App You Own
description:
Free skool for Solopreneurs and Content Creators: https://www.skool.com/the-ai-agency

A full MCP course for beginners: how to build real AI agents that connect to your actual apps, with no auth headaches. You connect your accounts once through Arcade.dev, then use those same tools everywhere: in Claude Code, the Claude desktop app and the web, in your own Python with LangChain and CrewAI, and in an agent that runs on a schedule on a server. 

By the end you have built five things, including your own MCP server that you deploy yourself, and a morning planner that reads your tasks and your calendar and blocks out your day for you.

Chapters
0:00 - Intro: what you'll build
0:56 - Create your first MCP gateway (Claude Code)
7:27 - Use it in the Claude desktop app
11:21 - Build your own MCP server (no code)
18:03 - Deploy it so it runs 24/7
24:32 - The same tools in your own code + the Arcade dashboard
29:45 - Code agent: LangChain (email + Slack)
34:16 - Code agent: CrewAI
38:19 - Build a scheduled agent (morning planner)
44:17 - Run it 24/7 on a VPS (Hostinger)
46:17 - Schedule it with Claude Routines
55:23 - Wrap-up + free code
